correctness.rationale: A complete finite design model has 16 points, 16 six-blocks and 320 facial triples. The symplectic pairing characterizes the 240 omitted triples, and the explicit mod-two edge cocycle evaluates to one on each omitted triangle and zero on all actual two-faces. An exact binary rank 104 of the triangle-boundary map, paired with 120 edges and rank 15 vertex-edge boundary, gives H1(F2) of dimension one. Every 65536 induced subset was enumerated to certify the sharp seven-vertex threshold and all sixteen block exceptions. The affine symplectic orbit and sixty isotropic planes were checked exhaustively using the actual standalone verifier. The Gram-matrix argument independently rules out noncarriers with seven or more vertices.

value.rationale: Determines the sharp intrinsic vertex-support threshold for nonzero mod-two first homology in the canonical Kummer biplane, exhibits all 240 minimum 3-edge carriers as one symplectic orbit, classifies all 60 isotropic planes and exactly sixteen maximal noncarrier blocks, and gives a full support enumerator. These are natural structural invariants unavailable from the previously known homotopy type, not routine restatements of the Betti number.
